caseNameFull: Bridgeforth v. Illinois and Davis v. Illinois

opinions.text: Appeals from Sup. Ct. Ill. Motions to dispense with printing jurisdictional statement and to dismiss in No. 71-1233 granted. Motion to supplement jurisdictional statement in No. 71-6422 granted. Appeals dismissed for want of substantial federal question. Mr. Justice Douglas would note probable jurisdiction and set cases for oral argument. Reported below: 51 Ill. 2d 52, 281 N. E. 2d 617.
